CREATE TABLE audio_presets (
      preset_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      world_template_id TEXT, -- NULL = shared
      preset_name   TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      settings_json TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
      modified_at   INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE brush_models (
      model_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      model_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      arch TEXT NOT NULL,
      weights BLOB NOT NULL,
      size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      modified_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE brush_shapes (
      shape_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      shape_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
      shape_size  INTEGER NOT NULL,
      shape_data  BLOB NOT NULL,
      size_bytes  INTEGER NOT NULL,
      created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
      modified_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )

CREATE TABLE presets (
      preset_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
      preset_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
      -- Slice 4: '' = shared/built-in (sentinel, NOT NULL so it can
      -- live in the PK); a template id means the preset (or the
      -- template's EDIT of a shared preset — owned shadows shared by
      -- preset_id) belongs to that world template.  Editing a preset
      -- in template A can no longer regenerate template B's terrain.
      world_template_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      preset_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      data        TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL,
      modified_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (preset_kind, preset_id, world_template_id)
    )

CREATE TABLE noise_preset_thumbnails (
      preset_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      signature  TEXT NOT NULL,
      thumb_data BLOB NOT NULL,
      thumb_w    INTEGER NOT NULL,
      thumb_h    INTEGER NOT NULL,
      mime_type  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'image/png',
      created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
    )
